# mcp-icloud

> Local MCP server (stdio, Python 3.11+, Linux and macOS) that lets AI agents manage iCloud+ Hide My Email addresses and read, organize and send iCloud Mail, all with one pyicloud login (mail via iCloud.com's web API, experimental; an IMAP/SMTP backend with an app-specific password is optional). Unofficial; not affiliated with Apple. MIT licensed.

Install: `uv tool install git+https://github.com/ak1tnk/mcp-icloud`. Server command: `mcp-icloud serve`. The human runs `mcp-icloud login` (Apple ID, password, 2FA) in a terminal, and optionally `mcp-icloud mail-login` (app-specific password, IMAP backend); agents must never ask for these secrets in chat. Hide My Email tools: hme_list, hme_generate, hme_reserve, hme_update, hme_deactivate, hme_reactivate (no delete). Mail tools: mail_list_mailboxes, mail_search, mail_read, mail_download_attachment, mail_set_flags, mail_move, mail_archive, mail_trash (move to Trash only), mail_send, mail_reply, mail_forward (send immediately), mail_save_draft.

## Docs

- [Agent setup guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ak1tnk/mcp-icloud/main/docs/agent-setup.md): step-by-step install, registration, checks, upgrade and uninstall, written for an AI agent to follow, with hard safety rules
- [README (English)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ak1tnk/mcp-icloud/main/README.md): what it does, the agent install prompt, manual install and registering with MCP clients, configuration (environment variables), using it on another machine, notes (send policy, revoking access, uninstall)
- [Prompts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ak1tnk/mcp-icloud/main/docs/prompts.md): copy-paste prompts in English, Japanese and Chinese for setup, everyday tasks, and a system-prompt snippet
